_meta.collector: v0.4.0 restructure, Inform phase (data collection only; no repository edits)
_meta.units: GB = 10^9 bytes, GiB = 2^30 bytes, rounded to 2 places; bytes and sha256 are exact (HF tree API lfs.size / lfs.oid)
_meta.kv_method: Bytes per token computed from the GGUF headers read today and the b11474 cache code (src/llama-model.cpp create_memory, llama-kv-cache.cpp, llama-memory-hybrid-idx.cpp, llama-kv-cache-dsv4.cpp, llama-hparams.cpp n_embd_r/n_embd_s). Block sizes: f16 2 B/element; q8_0 34 B per 32; q4_0 18 B per 32. Recurrent/SSM state is f32, per sequence, independent of context. Compute buffers are not included (Phase 3 measures them).

sources.headers: HTTP range reads of https://huggingface.co/<repo>/resolve/main/<file> (first 4-25 MB; GLM/DSV4/Flash-Next/Nemotron first shards read whole), parsed locally
sources.llama_cpp: git tree b9acf138 in the session clone (scratchpad lcpp.git); first-support tags by git tag --contains

_meta.engines_json_fields: Each Day 1 entry gives the inputs for engines.json: hf_repo, subdir, arch, licence, files[] (path, bytes, sha256), model_file_pattern, mmproj, quant, footprint (GB/GiB), native context, kv bytes/token, sampling for extra_args, min_llama_cpp_tag. files[].path is the repo path (existing entries keep the subdir prefix in name, e.g. "UD-Q4_K_XL/...").
_meta.verify_value: All Day 1 sha256 values come from the tree API read today. files_rule knows verify=unverified|research-snippet only; a tree-API-read hash is closest to research-snippet (compare at pull time, log a mismatch loudly) unless a new value is added to files_rule.
_meta.exclusion: No uncensored or abliterated engine was sourced; gpt-oss-120b-abliterated is out of scope and unchanged.
